entities.summary: Friedrich Maximilian von Klinger was a German dramatist and novelist. His play Sturm und Drang (1776) gave its name to the Sturm und Drang artistic epoch. He was a childhood friend of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe and is often closely associated with Jakob Michael Reinhold Lenz. Klinger worked as a playwright for the Seylersche Schauspiel-Gesellschaft for two years, but eventually left the Kingdom of Prussia to become a General in the Imperial Russian Army. Friedrich Maximilian Klinger was a authors & novelists from Frankfurt (1752-02-17, Frankfurt–1831-02-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Klinger's play Sturm und Drang influenced the development of German literature and had a significant impact on the aesthetic movement of the same name. His association with Goethe and Lenz also highlights his role in shaping the cultural landscape of 18th-century Europe.
